text: في الدقيقة 79، قرر فريق Westport Albion تغيير طريقة لعبه للدفاع عن تقدمه 3-2، فخفضوا من الضغط على الخصم وارتدوا للوراء قليلاً مع إبطاء اللعب[#1459]. هذا التغيير قلل فرصهم الهجومية من 4 تسديدات إلى تسديدة واحدة فقط، لكنهم نجحوا في منع Kingsmoor FC من خلق أي فرص تهديف[#1459]. طريقة اللعب الجديدة خلت Westport يتحكم أكتر بالكرة ويوفر جهد اللاعبين، وحافظوا على الفوز حتى هذه اللحظة[#1459].

- This tactical adjustment coincides with their style of direct, vertical passing from a 4-4-2 formation, aiming to limit Kingsmoor FC’s wide crossing opportunities, as Westport lowered pressing (ppda from 4.2 to 6.2) and reduced high turnovers to zero, implying a more controlled, possession-sparing approach [#1459].  
- Kingsmoor FC, playing 4-4-2 with wide crossing play, increased pressure numerically after the change (their ppda dropped from 7.8 overall to 3.4 in the last 10 minutes), but Westport’s deeper defensive block limited Kingsmoor’s ability to create clear shots, as indicated by Westport conceding zero goals while Kingsmoor registered no shots on target late in the game.  
- The change reflects Westport’s shift toward a low block defensive posture protecting a narrow lead, sacrificing forward momentum and shots (team xG fell from 0.34 to 0.24) to frustrate Kingsmoor’s crossing-based attacks and prevent conceding, consistent with their vertical, direct style restrained post-lead.
